# Applied to every pip run in regression.yml through PIP_CONSTRAINT.
#
# pip 26.3 (released 2026-11-02) refuses autobahn==23.1.2 from PyPI:
#   "Distributions from PyPI cannot declare direct URL dependencies.
#    autobahn depends on web3[ipfs] @ git+https://github.com/ethereum/web3.py.git
#    ... ; extra == "all""
# HARTOS's requirements.txt pins autobahn==23.1.2 and regression.yml installs
# it, so that install would fail with pip 26.3.  HARTOS caps pip the same way
# (its own .github/pip-constraint.txt).  Nunba's own autobahn==25.12.2
# installs under 26.3.  Lift this when HARTOS's pin moves.
pip<26.3
